background_notes.fact: In a field K of prime characteristic p, an integer a has zero image exactly when p divides a. Hence if 0<=r<p, the integer r! has nonzero image in K, including 0!=1. A unital ring map R->K sends each unit of R to a unit of K, and therefore to a nonzero element.

background_notes.justification: Divide an integer by p; its image is the image of its remainder.
